senses.gloss: Bhauma^1 = Naraka: III, 477 (Narakaṃ), 12590 (= do.); V, †1887 (Narakaḥ), †1892 (Narakaṃ), 5357 (do.); XII, 12956 (Narakaṃ).
Bhauma^2 = the planet Mars. § 775 (Ānuśāsan.): XIII, 166, 7643 (among the deities whose names remove sin).
Bhauma^3 (sc. astra, a celestial weapon). § 208b (Arjuna): I, 135, 5366 (employed by Arjuna: Bhaumena prāviśad bhūmiṃ).

Bhaumana (= Viśvakarman, Nīl., BR., etc.). § 46 (Garuḍa): I, 32, 1473 (the keeper of the amṛta).--§ 257 (Arjuna): I, 225, 8185 (bhuvanaprabhuḥ, had fabricated the car which was given to Arjuna by Varuṇa).--§ 561h (Arjuna): V, 56, 2220 (Tvashtā, Dhātā, etc., had decorated the flagstaff of Arjuna), †2223, †2224.
